---
name: design-question-engine
description: Ask progressive, high-value design questions in small batches and avoid repetitive or low-impact questions.
user-invocable: true
---
# Question Engine

Ask questions in dependency order: product -> user -> goal -> UX -> page hierarchy -> components -> visual language -> color -> typography -> grid -> imagery -> motion -> responsive.

Ask only questions that can change the design. Mark reasonable defaults when the user does not care.
